maddeler.e:
يلتهموا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَهِمُوا (yaltahimū) /jal.ta.hi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# يُلْتَهَمُوا (yultahamū) /jul.ta.ha.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
